# Navimower Map Card 0.3.0-beta6

## Home Assistant visual-editor hotfix

This prerelease fixes the configuration error shown when opening an existing Navimower Map Card or creating a new card in Home Assistant:

`Cannot assign to read only property 'type' of object '#<Object>'`

The synchronized color normalization introduced in beta5 now treats the configuration object supplied by Home Assistant as immutable. The card creates and passes a normalized copy to the stable card core instead of writing values back into Home Assistant's frozen object.

## Compatibility

- Existing YAML keys and saved card configurations remain unchanged.
- Color picker and manual HEX synchronization from beta5 remains enabled.
- Schedule save confirmation behavior remains unchanged.
- Both source and HACS distribution files contain the fix.
- Recommended backend remains Navimower integration `0.4.0-beta2` or later.

## Testing requested

After installing through HACS, verify that both an existing card and a newly created card open in the visual editor without the read-only `type` error. Also verify that changing colors through either the picker or HEX field still updates the preview and saves normally.
